name: nnnoiseless-web
description: Browser demo for the nnnoiseless speech denoiser, running as WebAssembly.

scripts.wasm: npm run wasm:web && npm run wasm:worklet
scripts.wasm:web: cd .. && RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+simd128" wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir web/src/pkg --no-default-features --features wasm,hush
scripts.wasm:worklet: cd .. && RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+simd128" wasm-pack build --target no-modules --out-dir web/src/pkg-worklet --no-default-features --features wasm,hush
scripts.build: npm run wasm && npm run typecheck && vite build && npm test
